elements.label: Headline 'Every web search' scrolling down and out
Blank headline band and grid cells scrolling with the text

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: No distinct transient or rising sweep visible at 20.21s in the spectrogram; only soft broadband music bed. CLAP 'riser' at 0.455 is weak.

pattern.description: The headline band 'Every web search' and the surrounding grid scroll downward together, accelerating, until the text leaves the bottom of the frame and an empty grid remains, like a page scrolling past inside a fixed viewport.
pattern.why_premium: The whole canvas moves as one surface rather than the text simply fading, so the sequence of 'Every ...' statements feels like a continuous document being scrolled; the grid lines give the motion a readable speed reference.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.canvas', {y: 520, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.in'}) with the headline and grid inside one container under an overflow-hidden viewport.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 18], [0, 520], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) applied to a single wrapper containing the grid and headline inside an overflow: hidden AbsoluteFill.

notes: camera.move is 'none' with pan_y 0.58, so this is content scrolling, not a camera tilt. The filmstrip crops a region around b02; the scroll direction is downward. b03 is a small diff region inside b01 and is not listed separately.
